description: This is a shell script (`pr_cycle.sh`) managing the review lifecycle for components based on their `metadata.yaml` files. It allows starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles, updating metadata timestamps and regenerating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists components by finding all `metadata.yaml` files excluding certain paths and sorting them.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to the `metadata.yaml` file of a given component, or displays error if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a given number of business days to a start date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle dates in a `metadata.yaml` file by setting them to a placeholder (~).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
